newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London advance slightly.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London advance slightly.

text.p: Japanese shares advanced slightly in London on Tuesday, despite a strong lead from Tokyo and amid some interest in shares of electrical companies, traders said.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index was up 2.54 points to 1590.08 points.

In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 index climbed 308.73 points, or 1.53 percent, to close at 20,532.55 points in thin trading ahead of Friday's expiry of June futures but triggered by a strong Wall Street and a stable yen.
"People are unwilling to take positions before Friday", one trader said. He expected trading to remain light during the week.
In London, Sony Corp was up 52.50p to 9,910 compared with 9,900 yen in Tokyo. Kyocera Corp gained 60p to 9,095p, retreating from its close of 9,120 yen in Tokyo.
